questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Every other facility can only __be enjoyed with__ the benefit of good health.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, **'No improvement required.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is grammatically correct and conveys the intended meaning.
 
• The phrase 'can only be enjoyed with' is the correct construction to express the idea that good health is necessary to enjoy other facilities.
 
• Option 1, 'being enjoying with,' is grammatically incorrect. The correct form would be 'being enjoyed with,' but this changes the meaning of the sentence to suggest that the other facilities are enjoying good health.
 
• Option 3, 'been enjoyed with,' is also grammatically incorrect. The past participle 'been enjoyed' does not fit with the present tense of the sentence.
 
• Option 4, 'enjoying for,' is grammatically incorrect and changes the meaning of the sentence. 'Enjoying for' suggests that good health is being enjoyed for the sake of other facilities, rather than the other way around.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2, **'No improvement required.**'

questions.question:

Explanation of options:

 
• 1) **Agile** - This word means quick and nimble in movement or thought. It is not an antonym of 'robust' as it does not convey the opposite meaning. 
 
• 2) **Healthy** - This word means in good physical or mental condition. While it is not an exact antonym of 'robust', it does convey a similar idea of being strong and sturdy. 
 
• 3) **Weak** - This word means lacking in strength or power. It is the correct antonym of 'robust' as it conveys the opposite meaning of being strong and sturdy. 
 
• 4) **Strong** - This word means having great physical power or mental power. While it is not an exact antonym of 'robust', it does convey a similar idea of being strong and sturdy.
